g.text: Container diagram for AX state, directory, enrichment, continuation, and cloning boundaries.
Browses, selects, confirms, launches, and attaches
Submits typed projected reads and guarded mutations
Queries and confirms exact directory plans
Rebuilds derived catalog and search index
Reads allowlisted source-local metadata and exact heads
Delegates existing AX ownership and provider effects
Uses Provider 2 and companion Session Adapter 1 transactions
Runs 'ax pane' wrapper in durable pane
Launches and orchestrates transactions via JSON-over-stdio
Materializes native state as directed by ax
Executes RPC (ax rpc serve --stdio) via SSH
Exchanges allowlisted immutable namespaces, including directory_record
